podcast.body: This album features the instrumental track "34 Ghosts 4," which was sampled by producer Young Kio to create the beat for Lil Nas X's "Old Town Road." The sample's use led to Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross receiving songwriting credits on the massively successful country-rap song. "He stumbled upon a track called 34 Ghosts 4, an instrumental from the 2008 Nine-H Nails album Ghost 1-4."

podcast.body: This collection of instrumental works, described by Trent Reznor as "soundtracks for daydreams," was first released online in March 2008 and later in various physical formats. Notably, it was released under a Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial Share-A-Like License, which permitted anyone to use the album's content for non-profit purposes, encouraging other composers to experiment and expand their skills. "The first called Ghosts 1-4 was released online in March 2008, and later released in a variety of physical forms."

podcast.body: This album, released by Trent Reznor in 2008, contains the track "34 Ghosts 4," which formed the basis of a beat later bought by Lil Nas X for his hit "Old Town Road." "He found that on a Nine Inch Nails record called Ghosts 1-4, which is a collection of orphaned instrumentals that Trent Rezner released in 2008."
